considerations: Vehicle access is available from E Barnett Rd into a large front parking lot that provides clear circulation and staging space. Additional paved parking and access exist on the left side and rear of the building. The structure is a single-story commercial building with a flat roof, multiple rooftop units, and storefront entries facing the parking lot. The property is part of a multi-tenant commercial complex surrounded by other retail buildings and large parking areas. Street frontage is direct and unobstructed.
